title: Pick up a task safely
purpose: Recover repository truth, select one owning harness/workflow, establish canonical path proof for local repo-backed actions, and declare a bounded write lane before mutation.
inputs: repository path or identifier if known
steps: Resolve repository identity without assuming the current working directory is a checkout.
Read AGENTS.md, HARNESS.md, the operational codebase map, workflow registry, and relevant domain map.
Inspect branch, HEAD, dirty state, active PR or stacked-parent relationship, plans, and validator ownership.
Classify the task as operational-harness, environment-capability, device-profile, application/offline-harness, Pi, GNHF, public-plan, documentation, or another explicitly mapped domain.
Select exactly one primary workflow and any required specialized skill.

Apply the workflow registry's canonical-path-proof action precondition before any local repository-backed mutation, validator/build/generator/launcher/updater invocation, local repository-derived artifact generation, or workstation command handoff. A provider-only remote read or static source inspection may be exempt only when it makes no local-adoption claim; record the exemption.

Resolve development checkout, production/use path, temporary worktree root, and real operator entrypoint through the registered machine/profile owner. Do not let the current working directory or model preference create a new canonical path.
Declare repository, branch, lane, owned paths, forbidden paths, artifacts, validators, proof ceiling, canonical path proof state, and commit/PR expectation.
Create an isolated branch or approved worktree when another writer or unrelated work exists; preserve dirty/diverged/noncanonical work instead of replacing it.
stopConditions: canonical path owner is unresolved for a required local action
requested work would mutate governance without a governance lane
another writer owns the same branch or paths
required live-target, credential, merge, deployment, or destructive authority is absent
outputs: canonical path proof disposition or recorded exemption
proofCeiling: Read-only intake, deterministic routing, and path-proof selection only. It does not prove a local path state until the canonical-path-proof workflow observes it.
